description: Compute the fixed monthly payment on an amortising loan or mortgage (the EMI), plus total interest and total repaid, using the standard annuity formula. Optionally returns the first months of the amortisation schedule showing the interest/principal split. Use it instead of estimating — compounding makes mental arithmetic unreliable here.

annual_rate_percent.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5. Use 0 for an interest-free loan.

schedule_months.description: How many months of the amortisation schedule to include.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (a 30-year mortgage is 360).

name: loan_payment
title: Loan / mortgage payment (EMI)
